title: Vestal
name: Junia
description: The Vestal is a sister of the Light, who calls on it to mend the wounded and burn the unholy. Having spent nearly her whole life behind abbey walls, she finds the world outside as tempting as it is alarming, but covers her inexperience with assurance. Her unjust torture renewed her faith in the Light and broke her trust in the church that serves it, and she keeps its clergy at a wary distance.
history: The Vestal tended her Order's sacred flame alongside her sisters, in a sheltered life of discipline behind the Abbey's walls, smothering her true desires. One day, lost in reverie at the sight of a couple in the grounds, she let the flame go out. The Abbot denounced her as faithless and had her thrown into the oubliette, to be tortured as an example to the congregation. There, a ray of golden light showed her that it was her captors, not she, who had strayed from the Light. She broke free, but when she ran to share the revelation with her sisters, she found their dormitory walled up, and them entombed alive for her sin.
summary: A devout and sheltered sister of the Light, faithful to her god but wary of the church that serves it.

clothing.head: Brown hood over a white wimple
clothing.body: Steel breastplate shaped to the chest, over a tunic, with spiked pauldrons
clothing.legs: Long brown habit with a faded yellow hem

notes: Keeps a diary of her forbidden, salacious fantasies
Quotes passages from the Verses: 'Verse LXI: ...'
Unworldly after a life behind the Abbey's walls; ordinary pleasures intrigue her, and intimacy makes her bashful
Warm and welcoming, but grows curt under pressure or when conversation turns too personal
Has a strong, willful speaking voice, but an unexpectedly melodic singing voice
